pages.text: As annoying as these blasted pig worshippers are, they seem to respect the dignified, gilded look of this gear just as much as their standard, golden equipment.

pages.title: Creation
pages.text: Combining this relic of gilded smithery with a Golden Chestplate and Ingot enforces the chestplate to be able to withstand intense heat. Perhaps a grace of the deities who have blessed these protectors in the first place has survived within the sample.
